heroTagline: Drummer. Bandleader. Professor of Jazz Drumset at the Jacobs School of Music.
heroTitle: Serve the music. Keep the joy.
heroPhilosophy: You've got to make the band feel good before you make yourself sound good.
shortBio: Sean Dobbins keeps time for Detroit. Two decades on the city's best bandstands beside Benny Golson, Dr. Lonnie Smith, Barry Harris and Mose Allison, and now the jazz drumset studio at Indiana University's Jacobs School of Music, where the next ones are learning to swing.
